The '''Warstalkers''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] army of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] warriors that existed by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were renowned for their skill and reliability with a well deserved reputation. Utilizing [[drouk]]s and droids alongside their elite Trandoshan forces, the Warstalkers were a significant threat to any in their way. In this time, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] hired them when they were being led by the veteran warlord [[Kephess]] due to manpower shortages with the intention of holding [[Denova]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] due to its supply of [[Baradium/Legends|Baradium]].<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Denova}}</ref>

However, despite their reputation, the Warstalkers went rogue and turned against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In addition, they allied themselves with renegades from the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]]. This led to them fighting both forces from the Republic and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] after they claimed the planet for themselves, eventually scattering following the defeat of Kephess.<ref name="TORC" />

Over the next few years, they would be remoulded and begin to regain their legacy under the command of [[Qyzen Fess]], a former companion of the Jedi known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]. Having gained his own clan prior to his friend's disappearance, Qyzen took over the Warstalkers and led them on various hunts across the galaxy. Eventually they would draw the attention of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], who recruited them in their campaign against the [[Eternal Empire]].
